title: Keep a merged worktree that still has tracked edits

rubric.text: Rejects the force-removal: a modified tracked file keeps the worktree even though the ticket merged.
Records the `git status --porcelain` output and reports the worktree as retained with the modified tracked file as its reason.
Does not run `git clean`, `git reset`, `git checkout`, `git restore` or delete untracked files to make the worktree removable.
Accounts for the worktree in the drain's finish accounting as retained with its reason, leaves the human to resolve the unexplained edit, and continues independent work without stalling the drain.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
